statement: As of created_utc the worker of session 6 has not opened the .S, objdump section, IR entry or Go source of the hold-out types; S1/S2 use only the development set (Epoch, Slot, CommitteeIndex, Checkpoint, AttestationData decoder). exposure_note_session7: Audit AU-09 (C-03, C-04), recorded before any hold-out opening: (1) the P1 development instances are identical modulo labels, so a ValidatorIndex success predicts little; (2) the generator has no encode mode; (3) BeaconBlockHeader and Eth1Data SizeSSZ code, their IR entries and generated Go were already in the repository and proved in phase1c; (4) session 1 printed one phase1c code-constant line that names a BeaconBlockHeader symbol (no code body). Any hold-out result is reported with these limits.

user_decisions.source: user decisions on T-7, AU-01, AU-09 (approved recommendations), relayed to the worker; recorded here before any hold-out opening (review fix-r1 S5)
user_decisions.H1: primitives.ValidatorIndex + v1alpha1.BeaconBlockHeader. Kept with limited claims: SizeSSZ is excluded from the hold-out claim, and the exposure above (AU-09) is reported next to any result.
user_decisions.H2: v1alpha1.Eth1Data, limited to UnmarshalSSZ and MarshalSSZTo (no SizeSSZ, no other method).
user_decisions.evaluation: Done by a separate evaluation session, not by a builder session. Builders and relays do not inspect hold-out inputs before that. scal/HOLDOUT-OPENED is committed before any opening; evaluation is kept apart from development; every adaptation is recorded in scal/CONTAMINATION.md.
user_decisions.claims: One out-of-sample case per type. No generator-superiority claim. No causal speed-up claim from types of unequal size. A timeout of a hold-out negative or build is reported as a timeout, not as a pass or a rejection.
user_decisions.limits_to_state: The generator has no encode mode. The P1 development instances are identical modulo labels. The encode template is net-negative in build time (P2EncCp, AU-07 open).
user_decisions.T-7: Deferred: GrowsliceC unchanged (no lower-bound or equality form, no Fk/* change, no generator or ELF change). The residual (3C) path stays unproved / differential-only. Never claim 'Checkpoint encoder complete'.
user_decisions.AU-01: Gate unchanged (serialization and 6 GiB cap kept); measure first; >= 2 s pause between a worker's consecutive gated jobs.
